convention_rule: Four repeated objects map to four candidates; the one odd green object marks the target. Position 3 from left read as the 3rd candidate by ascending ID (also the 3rd by ascending energy).
basis: A: four trees, only the 3rd from left is green and leafy. B: four campfires, only the 3rd from left burns green. Both point to slot 3. Ascending ID and ascending energy both give P3; the listed order would give P2. No examples, so confidence is low.
